name: YCharts direct-API generation, Opal-branded: persist and categorize every YCharts API response per call, map each report element to its source, and generate the three report types in Opal's branding with Opal's own script from the same data endpoints
description: Research plus one live thread. Opal's own script calls the YCharts data endpoints one at a time, keeps every answer in the client firm's private area of Opal's store with no secret in it, and records which answer each number, table and chart on a YCharts-made report comes from. It then makes Overview (FWD-1, the thread: one Cottonwood portfolio, live), Comparison and Multi reports in Opal's branding without YCharts' report builder; anything YCharts works out only inside its builder is rebuilt from data Opal holds or left out with a note, never imitated. Each run records where its time went (YCharts working kept apart from Opal waiting), and one one-time check per report type lists which figures agree with the YCharts report and why any differ. No second production path: the served YCharts generation (IRPT_BCKEND, the ~Y Analysis workstream) is undisturbed, research runs never interleave with it on the one session, and adoption of Opal generation would be a later decision that replaces the served path in the same window. No client-facing release is in scope.
